from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
zpath='inputs/scogs_fungi.zip'
with ZipFile(zpath) as z:
    names=[n for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
    print('all members',len(names))
    print('suffix classes',Counter('.faa.mafft' if n.endswith('.faa.mafft') else '.faa' if n.endswith('.faa') else PurePosixPath(n).suffix for n in names))
    alns=[n for n in names if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')]
    print('alignments',len(alns),'unique names',len(set(alns)))
    for n in alns[:3]:
        text=z.read(n).decode()
        seqs=[]; name=None
        for line in text.splitlines():
            if line.startswith('>'):
                name=line[1:]; seqs.append([name,''])
            else: seqs[-1][1]+=line.strip()
        print('\\n',n,'nseq',len(seqs),'lengths',[len(s) for _,s in seqs])
        print('\\n'.join(text.splitlines()[:8]))

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter
from statistics import median

with ZipFile('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip') as z:
    names=sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft'))
    result=[]; chars=Counter(); nseqs=Counter(); bad=[]
    for n in names:
        seq=[]
        for line in z.read(n).decode().splitlines():
            if line.startswith('>'): seq.append('')
            else: seq[-1]+=line.strip().upper()
        nseqs[len(seq)]+=1
        lens={len(s) for s in seq}
        if len(lens)"'!=1: bad.append((n,lens)); continue
        L=len(seq[0]); chars.update('"''.join(seq))
        pi_missing=0; pi_gapstate=0
        for col in zip(*seq):
            c=Counter(x for x in col if x not in '-?X')
            if sum(v>=2 for v in c.values())>=2: pi_missing+=1
            c2=Counter(col)
            if sum(v>=2 for v in c2.values())>=2: pi_gapstate+=1
        result.append((n,L,pi_missing,100*pi_missing/L,pi_gapstate,100*pi_gapstate/L))
    print('nseq distribution',nseqs,'bad',bad)
    print('character inventory',chars)
    print('median length',median(x[1] for x in result))
    print('median PI count',median(x[2] for x in result))
    print('median PI pct missing',median(x[3] for x in result))
    print('median PI pct gaps-as-state',median(x[5] for x in result))
    s=sorted(result,key=lambda x:x[3])
    for x in s[124:131]: print(x)
    print('pooled missing',100*sum(x[2] for x in result)/sum(x[1] for x in result))
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
from collections import Counter
from statistics import median

with ZipFile('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip') as z:
    rows=[]
    for name in sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.faa.mafft')):
        seqs=[]
        for line in z.read(name).decode('ascii').splitlines():
            if line.startswith('>'): seqs.append('')
            else: seqs[-1] += line.strip().upper()
        L=len(seqs[0])
        assert L and all(len(s)==L for s in seqs)
        pis=sum(1 for col in zip(*seqs)
                if sum(n >= 2 for n in Counter(c for c in col if c "'!= '"'-').values()) >= 2)
        rows.append((name,len(seqs),L,pis,pis/L*100))

    values=[r[4] for r in rows]
    ordered=sorted(values)
    mid=ordered[len(ordered)//2]
    central=[r for r in rows if r[4]==mid]
    print('processed',len(rows))
    print('taxon counts',dict(sorted(Counter(r[1] for r in rows).items())))
    print('zero-PIS alignments',sum(r[3]==0 for r in rows))
    print('median rank',len(ordered)//2+1,'of',len(ordered))
    print('median exact',mid)
    print('median rounded 2dp',f'{median(values):.2f}%')
    print('central row(s)',central)
    print('complete-four-only median',median(r[4] for r in rows if r[1]==4))
PY"
